title: Blueberry Muffins
desc: Soft muffins mixed gently for a tender crumb.
ingredients: Eggs, beaten and weighed without shells
steps: Preheat to 180°C fan. Line muffin tins for the displayed number of muffins; keep cup sizes the same when scaling.
Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
Whisk eggs, milk and oil separately, then fold into the dry mixture just until combined; small lumps are fine.
Fold in blueberries.
Divide evenly between the cups, about three-quarters full. Bake for 20–25 minutes until risen and a skewer comes out without wet batter. Cool on a rack.

title: Plain Scones
steps: Preheat to 200°C fan and line a tray.
Mix flour, baking powder and salt, sugar. Rub in cold diced butter until crumbly.
Stir in milk to make a soft dough.
Turn onto a lightly floured surface, fold gently twice and pat to 2.5 cm thick. Cut into the displayed number of equal pieces, handling as little as possible.
Bake for 12–16 minutes until well risen and golden. Cool briefly on a rack and serve warm.

title: Banana Bread
desc: A simple loaf cake for slicing and sharing.
ingredients: Eggs, beaten and weighed without shells
steps: Preheat to 160°C fan. Line a 23 × 13 cm loaf tin for the base batch; use more tins when scaling up and a smaller tin for a half batch, keeping a similar batter depth.
Mix flour, baking powder, salt and sugar in a bowl.
Whisk banana, eggs, oil and milk together, then fold into the dry ingredients just until combined.
Transfer to the tin and bake for 55–65 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cover loosely with foil if browning too quickly.
Cool in the tin for 15 minutes, then lift out and cool on a rack before slicing.
